sections.title: Execution Contracts
sections.content: Quick Dev TDD and Refactor Acceptance require explicit plan-bound contracts, deterministic routing, hash-bound evidence, append-only persisted runs, shell-free registered commands, and non-authorizing handoffs. Complete source coverage is present.

sections.title: Authority And Lifecycle
sections.content: AGENTS.md and ADR-0041, ADR-0048, ADR-0050, ADR-0057, ADR-0058, and ADR-0059 define ownership: Maintainer authorizes implementation, Quick Dev owns implementation-complete, Acceptance owns acceptance-passed, Bootstrap is not automatic, and Knowledge publication remains separate.

sections.title: Target Plan
sections.content: The acceptance-coordinator-trust-recovery plan, contracts, registry, requirements, repair materials, terminal runner, and maintenance/context requests define R0-R4 trust recovery, successor replay, Knowledge degraded refresh, legacy RED compatibility, and immutable historical evidence. Credential-bearing inputs are redacted.
